boundary_evidence: Contiguous run 0x0201ffcc..0x0202043c: 22 functions, each starting where the previous one ends (no padding word anywhere in the run), gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt. The first is the per-frame link step; the other 21 are accessors of the link settings bytes: each reads through GetLinkByte and/or writes through SetLinkByte (IsPlayerInSession through GetSessionPlayerMask), and their only relocations are bl calls to GetLinkByte, SetLinkByte, GetLocalPlayerId and GetSessionPlayerMask. There is no .rodata, .data, .bss, .init or literal pool.

Order: mwcc emits C bodies in reverse source order (tubuild verify: all 22 in ROM-ascending section order; swapping two definitions flips that pair), so the source order is the descending address order. Read that way the run starts with the link step and then walks the settings bytes in ascending order, 0 (warp, ready), 1 (course), 2 (player mask, rematch ready, go signal), 3 (course-select action), 4 (controller mode), and every field puts its getter first and its writers after it: one file laid out by subject and field.

LEFT EDGE: func_0201fec8 (ending at 0x0201ffcc) is the link start: it holds gWatchdog around one link call, stores func_0203daac() into data_0208f274, and owns and alone writes the link-started flag data_0209e64c. func_0201ffcc reads that flag and is its per-frame twin, so the left edge is a subject-change judgment rather than a cartridge fact. The continuous reverse-emission order across func_0201ffcc and all 21 accessors is the positive evidence for keeping the link step in this TU; no shared data or static initializer crosses the edge.

RIGHT EDGE: func_0202043c (0x0202043c..0x0202044c) restarts an OamAnimation and opens the OamAnimation run (func_0202044c, _Z13func_0202048cP12OamAnimationii, func_02020768) that leads into OAM.cpp; none of it touches the link. In .init, __sinit_func_0201fec8.cpp (0x02074e44) is followed directly by the empty initializer at 0x02074e80, which the tree files with func_0202043c.cpp, so nothing between them carries a static initializer, as a C file would not. Which TU owns that empty initializer is the tree's assignment, not a cartridge fact; the right edge rests on the subject change.
notes: HAND-BUILT manifest entry, not tools/tubuild.py create output: tu_map does not segment arm9.

Built as C: the cartridge cannot tell C from C++ linkage, and the tree has always named these unmangled, with LinkSettings.h's extern "C" block for the C++ callers. The file is named for that header, which declares the whole family; the TU name is coined like every name in it.

Folded from the 22 one-function sources: the 21 link settings accessors formerly in src/<symbol>.c and the link step formerly in src/unnamed/arm9/0201/func_0201ffcc.c. The four accessor bodies that declared their local after the early return (C99 style) now declare it first (C89 style), the locals are all named v, and PostControllerMode's `x & 0xff` is a (u8) cast like its siblings'; all 22 still match.
